<DOCSTRING>
Summary: Extends the functionality of Signer with time information, allowing signatures to be expired and validated based on timestamp.

Description: Created by the Signer class, used by callers to sign and validate values with time information. The class records the time of signing and can be used to expire signatures. The unsign method can raise SignatureExpired if the signature is expired.

Attributes:
    max_age (int | None): The maximum age allowed for the signature before it is considered expired. When set, it affects the validation logic.

Args:
    signed_value (str | bytes): The signed value to be unsinged and validated. Can be a string or bytes.
    max_age (int | None): The maximum age allowed for the signature. If the signature is older than this, SignatureExpired will be raised.
    return_timestamp (bool): If True, the timestamp of the signature will be returned as an aware datetime object in UTC.

Returns:
    tuple[bytes, datetime] | bytes: The unsinged value and the timestamp if return_timestamp is True. Otherwise, just the unsinged value.

Raises:
    SignatureExpired: If the signature is expired based on the max_age parameter.
    BadTimeSignature: If the timestamp is malformed or missing.
    BadSignature: If the signature is invalid.
</DOCSTRING>
